fields.name: SqlShardConnectionOptions.SqlShardConnectionConfiguration shard endpoint configuration
fields.description: The configuration shape for one shard endpoint: a shard identifier plus independently assignable read and write SQL connection configurations and their IDataConnection projections.

members.name: ShardId
members.description: Identifier of the shard represented by this configuration.

members.name: ReadConnection
members.description: SQL Server connection configuration selected for reads; a new instance initializes this slot with a new SqlConnectionConfiguration.

members.name: WriteConnection
members.description: SQL Server connection configuration selected for writes; a new instance initializes this slot with a new SqlConnectionConfiguration.

representations.C#: ShardId is short. ReadConnection and WriteConnection are settable SqlConnectionConfiguration properties initialized by property initializers; the corresponding Internal properties expose them as IDataConnection.
